card.name: The word loud and its pieces
card.fires_on: The end of the word loud when it is split up, such as LO-UD, L-oud and loud-ness, and sometimes the whole word loud. It is strongest in radio-loud, Read:OutLoud and sound-volume talk.

modes.label: Loud split into pieces
modes.description: The closing piece of loud in radio-loud, OutLoud or capitalised LOUD.
modes.example: Not far away, Daddy is quiet but Simon is LO<<UD>>, while a mother bird is silent as

modes.label: Loudness and whole loud
modes.description: The suffix after loud, or the whole word loud meaning noise.
modes.example: It seems that some increase in loud<<ness>> is inevitable when going to higher notes.

modes.label: Other weak cases
modes.description: Occasional word endings or descriptive words such as colorfully and sunny.
modes.example: View the color<<fully>> painted statues placed around the mountain-top region
